description: Before unlock, once a UTC day, the account's wallet can take its gains out in kind. Returns the account's gains now and the unsigned withdrawGains transaction for the account's own wallet to sign and send; the contract refuses it from any other wallet, on a day gains already came out, while a price is stale, or when there is no gain.

agentId.description: The ERC-8004 agentId on Robinhood Chain, as a decimal string or integer.

name: vlad_withdraw_gains_transaction
title: Get the gains withdrawal transaction
